title: Peter Cook
body: Professor Sir Peter Cook RA, founder of Archigram, former Director the Institute for Contemporary Art, London (the ICA) and Bartlett School of Architecture at University Col- lege, London has been a pivotal figure within the global architectural world for over half a century. His ongoing contribution to architectural innovation was most recent- ly recognised via the conferral of an honorary doctorate in April 2010, by the University of Lund, Sweden.
